sub_graphs.description: Functions for computing and verifying KZG multi-evaluation proofs.

invariants.text: For compute_kzg_proof_multi_impl: Q(X) = f(X) / Z(X) holds exactly when f(X) evaluates correctly at all points in zs.
For verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl: the verification equation is pairing(LL, LR) == pairing(RL, [1]).
The commitments list in verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl must contain no duplicates.
All commitment_indices must be less than len(commitments).

functions.description: Computes a KZG multi-evaluation proof for a set of k points.
preconditions: polynomial_coeff is a valid polynomial in coefficient form
postconditions: Returned proof is a valid G1 point
Returned ys[i] == evaluate_polynomialcoeff(polynomial_coeff, zs[i]) for all i

functions.signature: def verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch_impl(commitments: Sequence[KZGCommitment], commitment_indices: Sequence[CommitmentIndex], cell_indices: Sequence[CellIndex], cosets_evals: Sequence[CosetEvals], proofs: Sequence[KZGProof]) -> bool
functions.description: Verifies cells belong to commitments using a batched pairing check with the universal verification equation.
postconditions: Returns True if and only if all cells are valid evaluations of their committed polynomials

state_transitions.description: Step 1: Compute Fiat-Shamir challenge r and powers.
Step 4.2: Compute RLI using Lagrange interpolation.
Step 4.3: Compute RLP = sum_k(r^k * h_k^n * proofs[k]).
Step 4.4: Compute RL = RLC - RLI + RLP.

metadata.purpose: Data Availability Sampling (DAS) extension for polynomial commitments

title: Fulu -- Honest Validator
description: Defines the changes to the honest validator behavior for the Fulu fork. Covers custody configuration, modified BlobsBundle and GetPayloadResponse data structures with cell KZG proofs, the get_payload execution engine protocol, validator custody requirements that scale with effective balance, DataColumnSidecar construction from blocks and sidecars, sidecar publishing to subnets, and sidecar retention policy.

sub_graphs.name: Custody Configuration
sub_graphs.description: Defines the configuration constants governing validator custody behavior.

invariants.text: VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (8) >= CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (4): validators must always custody at least as many groups as regular nodes.
BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP is exactly 32 ETH (32 * 10^9 Gwei), matching the standard validator effective balance increment.

state_variables.name: VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT
state_variables.description: Minimum number of custody groups an honest node with validators attached custodies and serves samples from.

state_variables.name: BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP
state_variables.description: Effective balance increment corresponding to one additional custody group to custody.

sub_graphs.name: BlobsBundle Data Structure (Modified in Fulu)
sub_graphs.description: The BlobsBundle object is modified in Fulu (EIP-7594) to include cell KZG proofs instead of blob KZG proofs.

invariants.text: The proofs field contains exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_EXT_BLOB * MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK cell KZG proofs.
len(commitments) == len(blobs) <= MAX_BLOB_COMMITMENTS_PER_BLOCK.
Each blob's cell proofs start at index i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB and end at (i + 1) * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB in the proofs list.

data_structures.description: Modified in Fulu:EIP7594. Container for blob data returned from execution engine, now including per-cell KZG proofs.

sub_graphs.name: Validator Custody Requirement Computation
sub_graphs.description: Defines the mechanism by which validator nodes compute their custody requirement based on total effective balance.

invariants.text: VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT <= get_validators_custody_requirement(state, indices) <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS.
The custody requirement is deterministic given the same state and validator_indices.
Custody groups are computed from the total effective balance of all attached validators.
A node with at least one validator must custody at minimum VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT (8) groups.

functions.signature: get_validators_custody_requirement(state: BeaconState, validator_indices: Sequence[ValidatorIndex]) -> uint64
functions.description: Computes the minimum custody group count for a validator node.

sub_graphs.name: Validator Custody Behavioral Rules
sub_graphs.description: Specifies behavioral rules for honest validator nodes regarding custody advertisement, dynamic adjustment, and persistence.

invariants.text: The higher custody is advertised in the node's Metadata and ENR by setting custody_group_count.
A node with validators MAY custody, advertise, and serve more than the computed minimum.
A node MUST backfill columns when syncing, consistent with regular custody requirements.

behavioral_rules.text: A node SHOULD dynamically adjust its custody groups following any changes to the total effective balances of attached validators.
If the node's custody requirements are increased, it SHOULD immediately advertise the updated custody_group_count.
If custody requirements are increased, the node MAY backfill custody groups.
If a node's custody requirements decrease, it SHOULD NOT update the custody_group_count to reflect this reduction.
If custody requirements decrease, the node SHOULD continue to custody and advertise the previous (highest) custody_group_count.
If custody requirements decrease, the node SHOULD continue to respond to any DataColumnSidecar request corresponding to the previous (highest) custody_group_count.
The previous (highest) custody_group_count SHOULD persist across node restarts.
Nodes SHOULD be capable of handling multiple changes to custody requirements within the same retention period.
When a value for custody_group_count is set, the earliest_available_slot field in the status RPC message SHOULD reflect the slot at which the custody_group_count was updated.
If the node decides to backfill due to custody_group_count change, the earliest_available_slot field MAY be updated with progressively lower values as the backfill process advances.

sub_graphs.name: DataColumnSidecar Construction from Payload
sub_graphs.description: Defines the core mechanism for constructing DataColumnSidecars from blobs received via the execution engine.

invariants.text: For each blob i, its cell proofs in blobs_bundle.proofs span the range [i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB, (i + 1) * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB).
cells_and_kzg_proofs is constructed by pairing compute_cells(blob) with the corresponding proofs from blobs_bundle.proofs.
The number of DataColumnSidecars produced equals NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS.

invariants.text: len(cells_and_kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments).
Exactly NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars are produced.
Each DataColumnSidecar contains cells from exactly one column index across all blobs in the block.

sub_graphs.name: Sidecar Publishing Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Defines how DataColumnSidecars are published to the gossipsub network.

invariants.text: subnet_id = compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar(data_column_sidecar.index).
All columns associated with a block must be published to their respective subnets.
After publishing, peers on the network may request the sidecar through sync-requests.

behavioral_rules.text: The validator MUST publish each DataColumnSidecar to the data_column_sidecar_{subnet_id} pubsub topic.

sub_graphs.name: Sidecar Retention Policy
sub_graphs.description: Specifies the data retention requirements for DataColumnSidecars.

invariants.text: Sidecars MUST be retained for at least MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs.
During the retention period, sidecars MUST be served to requesting peers when the node is capable.

state_variables.name: MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS
state_variables.value: Referenced from Fulu -- Data Availability Sampling Core
state_variables.description: Minimum number of epochs a validator must retain and serve DataColumnSidecars.

behavioral_rules.text: The validator MUST hold on to sidecars for MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs and serve when capable.
After MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs, nodes MAY prune the sidecars.
